text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um... Thank you so much for the haskap 
berry sweets the other day. They were 
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wah! You ate it! I heard you liked sweet 
things, so... Ah, how was the tartness?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it had just the right amount of 
tartness... Though I didn't eat it very 
gracefully... I really shouldn't have 
eaten it with my hands.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry. If only I had let you know 
beforehand that using cutlery would be 
better—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... there's still a sweet 
fragrance lingering on my fingertips...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's so embarrassing to remember. 
I got jam on my lips... and kept licking 
it off with my tongue.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Even after all that, I couldn't get it all 
off, and sweet jam got all over my fingers 
and palms...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but that rich aroma and the luscious 
sweetness lingering on the palate... I 
don't think I'll ever be able to forget 
it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? Um... I'll bring some again, 
then! I'm so glad you like it!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes... I'm looking forward to it. ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(That's... just her review of the sweets, 
right? I—I feel like I've seen something I 
really shouldn't have...!)
